description: Land Acquisition - Wallampitiya, Kitthampahuwa and Welewattha, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition for public purposes under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and assessment numbers, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the main purpose of declaring land acquisitions rather than being about government personnel or structural changes.
